what: The build queue prints a test's stdout only when it fails, and keeps no log of a passing run (runner/ans holds the verdict alone, no `--nocapture` output). To report the phases a fixture ran (tasks and entries per phase) I had to turn a println into a panic, ask again with --no-admit, and put the line back: one extra queue turn.
cost: one queue turn (58 s) and two edits for numbers the passing run had already printed
cause: the runner reduces cargo test output to its summary and failure blocks, and drops the rest
whys: the summary keeps lanes' context small
nothing keeps the full output elsewhere
class: evidence a passing run produced is thrown away
prevention: keep each request's full test output at runner/out/<request>.log and print its path in the answer
annoyance: a lane cannot quote a passing test's own measurements
workaround: a temporary panic carrying the numbers, run with --no-admit
